content:
First touch: falls \(100\) cm.

After first rebound: up \(50\) cm and down \(50\) cm, so total \(100+100=200\) cm at second touch.

Second rebound height: \(50\% \times 50 = 25\) cm. Then up \(25\) cm and down \(25\) cm.

Total distance at third touch:
\[
200+25+25=250
\]

\boxed{250\text{ cm}}
